name: mnemo
description: Mnemo — local-first encrypted password manager prototype

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.pack:mac:local: node scripts/build-touch-id.js && MNEMO_LOCAL_TEST_BUILD=1 electron-builder --mac dir --config electron-builder.config.js -c.forceCodeSigning=false -c.mac.identity=- -c.mac.hardenedRuntime=false -c.mac.notarize=false
scripts.dist:mac:adhoc: node scripts/build-touch-id.js && MNEMO_VERIFY_MODE=adhoc-release electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.config.js --publish never -c.forceCodeSigning=false -c.mac.identity=- -c.mac.notarize=false -c.mac.entitlements=build/entitlements.adhoc.plist -c.mac.entitlementsInherit=build/entitlements.adhoc.plist
